decision: Re-establish a new browser surface, then reconcile server state before semantic resumption
facts: After the process restart, both the controlled tab list and user tab list were empty.
The prior game tab was no longer available for fresh observation.
The recovery record reopened the game at /home and reached a resume dialog.
The resume dialog reconciled server state to durable state at S1 weeks=1 and fans=1169, with no observed game-state damage or double commit.
A stable WING_HOME boundary was reached and persisted after reconciliation.
inferences: The surface must be recreated before any fresh observation can be made; the old tab cannot be assumed to survive restart.
The resume dialog and subsequent stable WING_HOME observation are required evidence before semantic business actions are considered.
The recovery should remain fail-closed until server-versus-durable state agrees; a lost surface alone does not prove an in-flight action outcome.
unknowns: The direct mechanism that caused the tabs to disappear is unknown.
Whether the prior session had an in-flight click at restart is unknown, even though later reconciliation showed no half-executed action.
No semantic action permission is established by the resume screenshot alone.
reason: Empty tab lists require creation of a new capture surface and fresh resume reconciliation. Only after the server state matches durable evidence and a stable boundary is observed can semantic resumption be evaluated.
